Cages & pathways

Shed A has 68 cages arranged in 4 rows flanking two longitudinal footpaths (North and South footpaths). Shed B has 19 total, split 10 and 9. Shed C has 20 total, split 10 and 10. Shed D is an open chicken enclosure.

Tap Inside to hide roofs. Cage dimensions, animal sizes and animal populations are illustrative. The cage counts above follow the current interpretation of your layout.

Kitchen and camera views

The medicine room is shown in the left half and the kitchen in the right half, with a connecting doorway. Select Kitchen, then Inside to see two walking people and the interior K1 camera.

G1 is beside the gate-facing corner of Shed A, aimed at the gate. K2 is outside the kitchen and also faces the gate. K1 faces into the kitchen room.

The network room remains at its original left-side location. It is moved only about 3 m farther from the cage area. Its rooftop switch, cable routes and distances follow this small adjustment.

Network equipment

16-channel NVR · 2 TB surveillance HDD · two 8-port PoE switches.

Switch 1 is shown on the network room roof and serves B1, B2, C1, C2 and D1. Switch 2 is shown on Shed A’s roof and serves A1–A4, G1, K1 and K2. Each camera cable connects to a distinct numbered port. The gold link joins the fibre endpoints at the two switches.

Quoted allowance is 400 m Cat 6 and 100 m fibre. The drawn routes are proposed. Confirm installed lengths, switch power and fibre terminations on site.

Map alignment & assumptions

Satellite imagery is georeferenced around 12.237876, 76.137735. The model is visually aligned using the three identifiable shed roofs from your screenshots. Small registration differences are expected.
